name: List.exists_pw_disjoint_with_card
statement: Type*} [Fintype α] {c : List ℕ} (hc : c.sum ≤ Fintype.card α) : ∃ o : List (List α), o.map length = c ∧ (∀ s ∈ o, s.Nodup) ∧ Pairwise List.Disjoint o

have_tree.name: hc'_lt
have_tree.type: ∀ l ∈ c.ranges, ∀ n ∈ l, n < Fintype.card α

name: Equiv.Perm.exists_with_cycleType_iff
statement: Multiset ℕ} : (∃ g : Equiv.Perm α, g.cycleType = m) ↔ (m.sum ≤ Fintype.card α ∧ ∀ a ∈ m, 2 ≤ a)
